findings.summary: Model aliases could overwrite and delete existing models
proof: All temporary aliases are canonicalized and must be nonempty, distinct, different from the source model, and absent from the pre-run Ollama inventory.
Cleanup removes only aliases recorded after a successful create call.
Collision regressions assert zero create and zero remove calls.

findings.summary: Setup failures bypassed evidence recording and cleanup
proof: All setup and execution stages now run inside the same failure-recording and cleanup scope.
A mocked identity-query failure writes a failed report and removes exactly the successfully created aliases.
Cleanup results are retained in report.json without recording exception text.

benchmark_rerun_reason: The remediation changes setup ownership and failure cleanup only; retained measured model execution and statistics are unchanged.
